title: Platform Rating Convergence
scenario: Find games where the difference between user_score and critic_score has narrowed to less than 1.0 points over a 3-game sequence.
tableSchema: ratings (game_id INT, platform VARCHAR, user_score NUMERIC, critic_score NUMERIC, release_date TIMESTAMP)
hint: Calculate rolling diff and compare with LAG().
correctQuery: SELECT game_id FROM (SELECT game_id, ABS(user_score - critic_score) as diff, AVG(ABS(user_score - critic_score)) OVER(PARTITION BY platform ORDER BY release_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_diff FROM ratings) t WHERE rolling_diff < 1.0;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, platform VARCHAR, user_score NUMERIC, critic_score NUMERIC, release_date TIMESTAMP);
